_comment: Guided-retrieval host registry (T5). Keyed by state abbreviation then municipality slug (lowercase, underscores for spaces). Municode entries are LANDING PAGES ONLY — never a constructed /codes/... code-path, because whether land-use rules sit under a separate Land Development Code or inside the Code of Ordinances varies by jurisdiction; the landing page lists what actually exists and the user picks. Every landing_url here has been verified to resolve 200 (sim-host-urls.js). A municipality NOT listed here gets a copyable search string client-side, never a fabricated link.

miami.notes: City of Miami. Land use is in the code; open the landing page and pick the zoning/land development title.

jacksonville.notes: Consolidated City of Jacksonville / Duval County.

hillsborough_county.notes: Hillsborough County — larger jurisdiction often has a separate Land Development Code; the landing page lists it.

lee_county.notes: Lee County — the originating customer's jurisdiction type (county board / special exception).

palm_beach_county.notes: Palm Beach County — Unified Land Development Code appears on the landing page.
